exposure: inadequate maternal weight gain during pregnancy
Women with elective repeat caesarean deliveries at 38 weeks
timing of elective repeat caesarean delivery
Inadequate maternal weight gain during pregnancy
cohort: 1152 women with repeat caesarean deliveries planned at 38 weeks gestation between 2005 and 2019 at a tertiary referral hospital in Japan
finding: History of vaginal deliveries, history of preterm deliveries, and inadequate maternal weight gain during pregnancy significantly increased the risk of early-term spontaneous labour onset; however, early-term labour onset did not increase the likelihood of neonatal complications.
